root_cause.text: The nft_exthdr_init function fails to validate that the user-controlled length parameter matches the fixed 1-byte write size used during evaluation when the NFT_EXTHDR_F_PRESENT flag is set, causing the register tracker to incorrectly mark uninitialized stack memory as initialized.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "nft_exthdr_init() passes user-controlled priv->len to nft_parse_register_store(), which marks that many bytes in the register bitmap as initialized" while "eval paths write only 1 byte", and the patch adds the check `if ((flags & NFT_EXTHDR_F_PRESENT) && len != 1) return -EINVAL;` to enforce consistency.
